heroHeadline: US measles cases surge to 2,777 as Pennsylvania reports the year's first deaths — and CDC disputes the state's account
heroSubtitle: 47 jurisdictions affected, 94% of cases outbreak-associated. Two unvaccinated Lancaster County, PA residents died Aug 25 — the first 2026 deaths nationally — but CDC publicly questioned the state's 'measles-associated' framing days later, as a new outbreak was declared in Seneca County, NY. PAHO's US elimination status decision remains due November 2026.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
